user.title: Set up Energy Engine
user.description: Point to the existing entities that report your grid import and export energy. This is the single, shared Energy Profile used by every Scenario you add afterwards.

add_scenario.title: Add a Scenario
add_scenario.description: A Scenario prices the shared Energy Profile against one Tariff Provider. Point to the existing entities that report its import rate, export rate, and standing charge.

error.name_exists: A Scenario with this name already exists.

run_scenario.name: Run Scenario
run_scenario.description: Prices the shared Energy Profile against one Scenario's Tariff Provider over an explicit date range.

run_comparison.name: Run Comparison
run_comparison.description: Targets multiple Scenarios at once and prices each over the same explicit date range - an ad hoc Comparison.
